Meaning: The reference reports the neat polymer resistant to the agent under the stated conditions.
The reference reports limited or conditional resistance: swelling or attack under some conditions.
The reference reports the neat polymer attacked or degraded by the agent.
The reference reports the neat polymer dissolved by the agent (water for a support material).
The reference reports the neat polymer absorbing the agent (moisture uptake) without stating attack.
The reference reports resistance only with a stabiliser or additive the neat polymer does not carry.
